140.note: Signature-matches the validated M279 ST140 (paid_spin/NormalCollectionSpin): the base PAID reel spin (BetAmount>0, CostCredits>0 on 40,000/40,000) with NATURAL payline payids (WinCredits==sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount) on 40,000/40,000, residual 0) and WinCredits sum == server FeatureWin 'NormalCollectionSpin' (22,768,400 ~= 22,808,457, SummaryWin aggregation granularity). STRICT-REUSE the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (no new plugin). The collect-coin signature fields (CreditsSymbols, SymbolIndexToRewards, CollectCount, AccCredits) are PRESENT-but-DORMANT on this machine: CreditsSymbols='' on 40,000/40,000 and SymbolIndexToRewards={} on 40,000/40,000 -> NO live additive coin channel, NO _unattributed_residual (every credit flows through a real payline pid). CollectCount is a 0..N metronome (resets to drive the Wheel collect settlement, M279 precedent). This is the clean-collect case (M279), NOT a live collect-coin channel (no ABORT). CurJackpotStoreWin present=0 on 40,000/40,000 (fleet-wide test-interface-zeroed; kept in signature for forward-compatibility).
